title: Concept: Full amortisation schedule returned in a response
description: An amortisation schedule array with principal and interest splits per period in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A full schedule discloses the interest the bank expects to earn over the life of the loan, and it is a large payload the client does not need to render a single instalment.
applicability: Deployments that render an amortisation schedule array with principal and interest splits per period into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A full schedule discloses the interest the bank expects to earn over the life of the loan, and it is a large payload the client does not need to render a single instalment.
